title: Generalized Weight Polynomials of Codes through Flats and Orlik-Solomon Algebras of Matroids
summary: We present various ways of determining generalized weight polynomials of a matroid $M$, and we recall how one can find the generalized weight spectra of a linear code, given these polynomials, for the matroid determined by any generator matrix of the code. A main goal is to give coding theorists different ways to determine these polynomials.
